scenes: Nadia's niece was born three days ago. Her family introduces the newborn during a video call. Her brother says the baby is sleeping, while an infant cousin plays nearby.
Which word specifically describes a baby in the first few weeks of life?
Newborn
Nadia's nephew is learning to walk. The toddler takes a few steps while an adult stays close. His sister is a preschooler, and an older child shows her a picture book.
Which word describes the child learning to walk?
Toddler
Nadia shares a photograph from her childhood. In it, she is a youngster playing with a neighbor. She laughs and says, 'I was a very energetic kid.'
Which word names the period of life Nadia remembers?
Childhood
Nadia compares two photographs of her nephew, a teenager. His growth is clear because he is much taller in the newer photograph. The adolescent also talks about his changing interests.
Which word describes the increase in his height?
Growth
Nadia's niece is sixteen. In an informal message, Nadia calls her a teen. They discuss how interests can change during youth, and her niece recalls learning about puberty at school.
Which informal word refers to the sixteen-year-old?
Teen
ages-life-stages-1.reading: Nadia calls her sister to meet a newborn niece. The baby is only three days old. Nadia also sees her nephew, a toddler who is learning to walk. Later, the family looks at old photographs. Nadia remembers her childhood games and notices how much the children have grown. She asks her sixteen-year-old niece about school before the call ends.
readingQuestion: How old is Nadia's newborn niece?

scenes: Nadia remembers her nephew's growth spurt, when he became taller very quickly. Now he is a young adult. At a family gathering, he talks about coming of age and taking on new responsibilities.
Which expression describes his rapid increase in height?
Growth Spurt

A family event offers one form for an adult and another for a minor. Nadia's thirty-year-old cousin uses the adult form. The organizer explains that 'juvenile' is another formal term used for a young person.
Which word describes the thirty-year-old cousin?
Adult

During a disagreement, Nadia's middle-aged cousin listens calmly and suggests a fair solution. Nadia describes this sensible behavior as mature. A child watching says, 'I want to handle problems like that when I am a grown-up.'
Which word describes the cousin's sensible behavior?
Mature

Nadia's cousin now lives alone and manages his own bills. He is independent and responsible about paying them on time. He feels he is in his prime because he enjoys his work and has energy for his hobbies.
Which word describes his ability to manage his own life?
Independent

Nadia asks a trained photographer to take a family portrait. The experienced professional explains the service and confirms the booking. She arranges comfortable seating for Nadia's elderly relatives.
Which word refers to the trained photographer doing this work?
Professional
ages-life-stages-2.reading: Nadia's cousin has started living in his own apartment. He is a young adult and wants to become more independent. Before moving, he makes a budget and checks the bills he will need to pay. His aunt gives advice, but he makes his own decisions. When a problem occurs, he discusses it calmly. Nadia thinks his response is mature and responsible.
readingQuestion: What does Nadia's cousin check before moving?
The bills he will need to pay

scenes: Nadia's aunt is a senior who stopped working last month. The retiree now spends more time with friends and enjoys being a grandparent.
Which word describes someone who has stopped working after a career?
Retiree
Nadia asks her uncle for advice about a difficult decision. His wisdom comes from knowledge and experience. During retirement, he leads a discussion group about aging and changes in everyday life.
Which word describes his ability to give thoughtful advice?
Wisdom

Nadia's grandmother has lived for more than ninety years. The family celebrates her longevity at a gathering. This respected elder says she enjoys spending her golden years with friends and relatives.
Which word refers to her long life?
Longevity
The family album records a child's birth and first words. Nadia adds a new video showing her nephew's first steps: he walks a short distance for the first time.
Which milestone does the new video show?
First Steps
Nadia's brother has just started his first job, a paid position at a shop. He puts a photograph from work beside pictures of his school start and graduation in the family album.
Which milestone has Nadia's brother just reached?
First Job
ages-life-stages-3.reading: Nadia's aunt has recently retired. She plans to spend time with her grandchildren and meet friends during the week. At a family lunch, Nadia asks her uncle for advice about a new job. He listens before sharing what his experience has taught him. Later, they watch a video of a toddler taking his first steps. Everyone talks about a different stage of life.
readingQuestion: What advice does Nadia ask her uncle for?

scenes: Nadia's grandparents helped many neighbors learn to read. Their kindness still inspires the family, and Nadia calls this their legacy.
Which word describes their lasting influence?
Legacy
ages-life-stages-4.reading: Nadia interviews her grandparents for a family album. They talk about their marriage and the changes that came with parenthood. They also describe helping neighbors learn to read. Nadia wants the album to preserve these memories for younger relatives. She writes about the kindness that still influences the family. For her, this lasting influence is an important part of her grandparents' legacy.
readingQuestion: Why does Nadia make the family album?
To preserve the memories for younger relatives
